note: Pre-check (read-only): fail early, before touching anything, if an INVALID index named orders_customer_id_idx exists (e.g. a half-finished earlier CONCURRENTLY build), because IF NOT EXISTS below would silently skip it. On the live database today the index already exists and is valid, so this passes.

Build the index without blocking traffic. CONCURRENTLY takes only a SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE lock, so the app's INSERTs and SELECTs keep running throughout. (customer_id, id) serves the customer page's WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10 directly from the index. IF NOT EXISTS makes this a no-op when the index is already there (it is, on the live database today). It's a step by itself because CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block.
